title: Payment API returning intermittent 500 errors
observations: Postgres active connection count at 50/50 max limit
No root cause is known yet
evidence: Heap dump confirmed 42 unreleased asyncpg socket descriptors in payment webhook worker
Database server CPU was normal (28%), confirming issue was client-side socket leak
verification: Active DB connections stabilized at 12/50 under full production load
root_cause: Worker process had a connection leak in async webhook callback handler (database sockets unreleased on client disconnect).
resolution: Restarted affected worker processes and deployed connection-pool context manager fix in v2.4.2 hotfix.

timeline.event: Incident INC-REAL-01 recorded for Payment API
Incident resolved: Worker process had a connection leak in async webhook callback handler (database sockets unreleased on client disconnect).

engineer_feedback: Alex Rivera (Day Shift SRE) confirmed fix. Night shift should monitor connection pool.
